ns0:section.ns0:heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 104–134, title I, § 101[(a)] [title VI, § 614(a)(1)], Apr. 26, 1996, 110 Stat. 1321, 1321–65; renumbered title I, Pub. L. 104–140, § 1(a), May 2, 1996, 110 Stat. 1327]

ns0:note.ns0:p: Section, added act Sept. 30, 1950, ch. 1115, § 4, 64 Stat. 1090; amended Oct. 12, 1984, Pub. L. 98–473, title II, § 223(p), 98 Stat. 2030, provided for creation of Advisory Corrections Council.

ns0:note.ns0:heading: Effective Date of Repeal
ns0:note.ns0:p: Pub. L. 104–134, title I, § 101[(a)] [title VI, § 614(b)], Apr. 26, 1996, 110 Stat. 1321, 1321–65, provided that: “This section [repealing this section] shall take effect 30 days after the date of the enactment of this Act [Apr. 26, 1996].”
